verdict.rationale: Floot documents an official remote MCP server exposing tools (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, generate_image, create_checkpoint, etc.) that let AI clients like Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor drive the product programmatically, which serves as its public 'API' for AI-native use. However, probes show no traditional REST/OpenAPI spec (openapi.json, docs.md all 404), so the documented interface is limited to MCP tool calls rather than a full public API. Missing for 10: a general-purpose REST/OpenAPI-documented API beyond MCP tool set, and independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
